subject.kind: a Claude Code skill: SKILL.md, playbooks, scripts and a page template
subject.purpose: grade any target into an HTML report card: find its subject, derive a rubric, grade it with evidence, show the page (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1046)
subject.reader: the owner, who reads the report card, and the agents that run the skill; a wrong or unreadable card sends the owner to fix the wrong thing
frameworks: research on rubric grading and report design, cited in references/report.md

folder-named-card.evidence: Command: find TARGET -maxdepth 1; grep '^name:' SKILL.md -> 'name: card'; no rubric folder beside it in TARGET parent (only card/).
folder-named-card.why: Name is card and no rubric folder exists.

step-profile-subject.evidence: Subject: read the target and write its kind, purpose and reader, each with a quote or path that shows it
step-profile-subject.why: Names all three facts and comes before the Rubric step.

step-derive-rubric.evidence: Rubric: write the spec ... drawing criteria from the frameworks and the target's own stated purpose; subject 'picks the frameworks the criteria come from'
step-derive-rubric.why: Criteria derive from the subject step's frameworks and purpose.

step-grade-target.evidence: Grade: delegate the grading to fresh subagents ... Each quotes the evidence first, then gives the verdict
step-grade-target.why: The skill's own step produces a verdict per criterion on the target.

output-html-report.why: A step names the graded HTML page built from the grades file.

report-built-like-peers.evidence: scripts/make-report.py and assets/report.html exist, but examples/ holds only .json files (find -name '*.html' found only assets/report.html); no finished sample report.
report-built-like-peers.why: Template and script exist but there is no sample HTML in examples/.
report-built-like-peers.fix: Add a built sample report .html to examples/.

stops-at-rubric.evidence: Steps 4 Grade and 5 Report follow the Rubric step
stops-at-rubric.why: Grade and Report steps exist, so the error is not committed.

verdict-fix-first.evidence:
page leads with the verdict and the fix list, highest tier first; make-report.py body(): verdict section, '

Fix first

', then '

Criteria

'
verdict-fix-first.why: Order is verdict, fix list, then cards.

blended-number-first.evidence: never with one blended number; headline is verdict_sentence plus a count per tier ('N of M met')
blended-number-first.why: Headline is a tier statement, not a blended score.

evidence-before-verdict.evidence: Each quotes the evidence first, then gives the verdict
evidence-before-verdict.why: Instruction order puts the quote first.

no-quote-not-met.evidence: report.md says 'a verdict with no quote is not met', but schema grade evidence is a plain string with no minLength and make-report.py build() only refuses empty evidence in --check on examples (lines 203-204); no script zeroes an empty-evidence verdict. Command: grep -n 'bare' scripts/make-report.py
no-quote-not-met.why: Only prose and an examples-only check; grading input is not rejected by a script.
no-quote-not-met.fix: Make grades validation (or make-report build) reject or zero a grade with empty evidence.

judge-is-fresh.evidence: delegate the grading to fresh subagents, never the context that wrote or revised the target, giving each only the target, the spec and the grades grammar
judge-is-fresh.why: Fresh context with only target and spec.

rubric-frozen.evidence: Freeze: take the spec's sha ... before any grading ... a spec edited after grading is caught; no statement that a later change is logged as a new version (searched 'version' in references).
rubric-frozen.why: Spec is saved and hashed, but a post-grading change is refused, not logged as a new version.
rubric-frozen.fix: Say a rubric change after grading is saved and logged as a new version.

failed-card-fields.evidence: Feed forward: each failure carries its evidence, its reason and a fix; card shows criterion text, Evidence, why, Fix
failed-card-fields.why: Criterion, evidence, reason and fix are all required on a failed card.

status-not-colour-alone.evidence: every verdict is a word and an icon as well as a colour; status_word returns '✓ Met' / '✗ Not met'

not-judged-section.evidence: Searched 'judged|unjudged|could not be' in SKILL.md, references/*.md, make-report.py: none; grade schema only has met 0|1.
not-judged-section.fix: Add a Not judged section with a reason per criterion, kept out of counts.

description-use-when.evidence: description: Use when a target, such as a document, ... Not for a quick A-against-B check of a change. (command: wc -c on the description gave about 300)
description-use-when.why: Starts with Use when; length checked below.

routes-to-references.evidence: Route table rows: ask -> references/report.md, author.md, calibrate.md, grade.md, repair.md
routes-to-references.why: Table sends each case to one reference file.

code-computes-in-scripts.evidence: Scripts compute: ... check-spec.py, score-spec.py, measure-judge.py ...; report cards come from make-report.py
code-computes-in-scripts.why: Counting, scoring and page building are scripts named verb-noun.py.

no-agents-or-tests-dirs.evidence: Command: find . -type d \( -name agents -o -name tests -o -name evals \) printed nothing

body-short-flat.evidence: wc -l SKILL.md = 37; but references/spec/changelog.md is referenced only from rubric.schema.json (grep -rln changelog.md), not from SKILL.md
body-short-flat.why: A reference file is not linked directly from SKILL.md.
body-short-flat.fix: Link references/spec/changelog.md from SKILL.md, or remove it.
